column3: Use in-process ASGI for BootUI's fixed loopback GET then OPTIONS probes to preserve the no-socket boundary; listener-added headers and TLS are unobservable and dependent results are incomplete. Apply BootUI's 8 KiB body, decoded body and header-retention limits; connect timeout and redirect handling are inapplicable to direct ASGI calls.
Apply a deadline to cooperative asynchronous host calls; a synchronous host callable blocking the event loop cannot be interrupted in-process and is reported as a transport limitation.
Send BootUI's literal loopback Host; a host TrustedHost rejection is incomplete evidence rather than a scan of its 400 error page.
Do not expose raw body, exception text, or unsafe response header values; retain only bounded sanitized evidence to preserve sharpit's masking boundary.

Require the fixed missing-resource probe to return 404 before evaluating error-body checks; other statuses make those checks indeterminate with status evidence so catch-all routes cannot appear clean.

Run the in-process ASGI probe as cooperative async work on the request event loop; acquire SingleFlight.try_acquire and release in finally after cancellation, while synchronous code blocking that loop stalls the host and cannot be interrupted.

The Python adapter evaluates bounded HTTP response checks; Spring Security, servlet configuration, JVM serialization, and Actuator metadata have no Python source equivalent and remain explicit coverage limitations.
